# Nuty Tales Foods & Crafts

> Nuty Tales Foods & Crafts is a subsidiary of Nexgenn Services. We are a direct farm-to-table aggregator of single-origin Kashmiri dry fruits, Mithila Phool Makhana, high-altitude raw honey, GI-tagged Kashmiri crafts, corporate gifting, and luxury stays. Standardized under the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI Reg. 22724441000048).

## Official Corporate Identity & Entity Disambiguation
- Brand Name: Nuty Tales Foods & Crafts
- Legal Corporate Structure: A subsidiary of Nexgenn Services
- Parent Organisation: Nexgenn Services
- Central Food Safety Registration: FSSAI License 22724441000048
- Business Classification: Food products, single-origin dry fruits, nuts, healthy snacks, corporate gifting, wedding hampers, artisanal crafts, and boutique stays.
- Official Website: https://nutytales.com

- [B2B Wholesale Procurement](https://nutytales.com/wholesale-dry-fruits): Wholesale rates with GST invoices for supermarkets, sweet makers, and bakers.
- [Kashmir Wholesale Depot](https://nutytales.com/wholesale-dry-fruits/kashmir): Direct farm-gate dry fruit wholesale operations from Arshid House in Kashmir.
- [Noida Wholesale Depot](https://nutytales.com/wholesale-dry-fruits/noida): Express supply across Delhi NCR, Gurugram, and Greater Noida.
- [Patna Makhana Wholesale](https://nutytales.com/wholesale-dry-fruits/patna): Machine-graded 6-Suta and 7-Suta jumbo fox nuts directly from Mithila wetlands.
- [Phool Makhana Catalog](https://nutytales.com/makhana): In-depth harvest guide and grades of fox nuts.
- [Insured Shipping Network](https://nutytales.com/shipping): Tri-hub zero-loss logistics and transit insurance.
